name: Schemes Of H.P. Backward Classes Finance & Develpoment Corporation
benefit: To provide support and empowerment of Social, educational and economic upliftment of the notified backward classes living below the poverty line.
eligibility_rules: Persons living in rural areas of backward classes in the age group of 18 to 55 years whose annual income is 98,000/- and persons living in urban areas whose annual income is less than Rs.1,20,000/-.
documents_required: It is mandatory for the eligible person to submit his application on the prescribed form along with Caste certificate. Income
certificate. Age certificate. Himachali certificate issued by the executive magistrate.
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline It is mandatory for the eligible person to submit his application on the prescribed form along with caste certificate, income certificate, age certificate and Himachali certificate issued by the executive magistrate.
